scenario: An xfs mount whose super options carry only uqnoenforce and pqnoenforce (user and project quota accounting without enforcement) and no noquota: quota is visibly enabled but not enforced.

33 33 0:30 /@ / rw,noatime shared:1 - btrfs /dev/mapper/root rw,compress=zstd:3,ssd,discard=async,space_cache=v2,subvolid=256,subvol=/@
65 33 0:30 /@home /home rw,noatime shared:183 - btrfs /dev/mapper/root rw,compress=zstd:3,ssd,discard=async,space_cache=v2,subvolid=257,subvol=/@home

251 33 259:3 / /srv/xfsacct rw,nosuid,nodev,noatime shared:214 - xfs /dev/nvme0n1p3 rw,inode64,logbufs=8,logbsize=256k,uqnoenforce,pqnoenforce

rationale: Contract row: contract.md §C2 quota-classification table, xfs row 3 - 'xfs | only *noenforce keys (uqnoenforce,gqnoenforce,pqnoenforce,qnoenforce), no `noquota` | enabled | accounting_only | `xfs_quota_option`'. The fixture's chosen mount carries exactly uqnoenforce and pqnoenforce and no noquota, so row 3 is the only matching row: xfs row 1 needs `noquota` (absent), xfs row 2 needs one of usrquota,uquota,quota,grpquota,gquota,prjquota,pquota (none present), xfs row 4 needs `noquota` together with a quota key (no noquota), xfs row 5 needs neither `noquota` nor any quota key (a quota-related key is present). Mount resolution (contract.md §C2, 'Candidate mounts: mount point equals realpath, or is `/`, or realpath starts with mount point + `/`. Choose the longest mount point'): realpath /srv/xfsacct/data is covered by /srv/xfsacct (length 12) and by / (length 1); the longest wins, so mount_point is /srv/xfsacct and fstype is xfs; the btrfs / and /home lines, the tmpfs /run line and the xfs /tmp line (noquota) do not cover the path. Device check (contract.md §C2): fstype is not btrfs, so the mount's major:minor must equal the path's st_dev - the fixture line carries 259:3 and the fixture path carries st_dev '259:3', so the equality branch holds and the path is not collapsed to unknown/device_mismatch. Option extraction (contract.md §C2, 'super options = last mountinfo field, comma-split, key = text before `=`'): the last field of the chosen line is 'rw,inode64,logbufs=8,logbsize=256k,uqnoenforce,pqnoenforce', whose quota-related keys are uqnoenforce and pqnoenforce; inode64, logbufs and logbsize are not quota keys and the values are never echoed. Verdict (contract.md §C2, 'Verdict precedence: setup error -> 2 QUOTA_SETUP; else any `enabled` -> 1 QUOTA_ENABLED ...; else any `unknown` -> 2 QUOTA_STATE_UNKNOWN; else 0 QUOTA_DISABLED'): the single path is enabled, so exit 1 with finding_id QUOTA_ENABLED. Fixture text note: the mountinfo text ends with a trailing newline, exactly as a real /proc/self/mountinfo does, and every line is byte-shaped like a real mountinfo line (mount ID, parent ID, major:minor, root, mount point, mount options, optional tagged fields, '-', fstype, source, super options). The btrfs and tmpfs lines are structural decoys only - they make the mount resolution non-trivial and are not claimed to reproduce any observed host mount.
